scope: Universal Vulkan diagnostic capability, not a gameplay fix
implementation: Enable deviceFault only when advertised and supported, preserving the existing feature chain. Query once after VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST with fixed 64-address and 16-vendor arrays, bounded descriptions and no binary dumps. No normal-frame polling, shader changes or injected input; enabling diagnostics can affect driver instrumentation overhead.
driver_safety: Reviewed Mesa 25.0.7 radv_GetDeviceFaultInfoEXT. If the first query unexpectedly returns nonzero vendorBinarySize, refuse the second query rather than expose a null binary destination to its unchecked internal report copy. Preserve counts and truncated status.
capture_change: Pinned observer logs screenshot failures and tries bounded software ffmpeg X11 capture as fallback. No input or display configuration changes; this fixes silent evidence loss, not rendering.

local_tests.protocol: 15 simulated-response CPU cases PASS with GCC14 and Clang17 strict release and ASan+UBSan builds
local_tests.initial_fixture_failure: Generic lambda could not deduce a nullptr argument; fixed explicit Vulkan pointer types in fixture before final passes
local_tests.header_limit: Local declarations are type collaborators, not actual Vulkan SDK headers. Host must compile against actual project Vulkan headers first.
local_tests.rollback: Real Git and patch operations PASS for build-failure restoration, simulated runtime-success restoration, simulated runtime-failure/nonzero restoration and dirty-source refusal. Native build/game operations were stubbed for these four control-flow tests.
local_tests.captures: Five mocked subprocess cases PASS: no backend, ImageMagick success, fallback success, both failing, timeout with partial-file cleanup. No real display tested locally.
local_tests.shell: Exact pinned runtime template substitutions and bash -n PASS; observer stand-in not executed in this composition-only test
local_tests.python: AST PASS and published blob matches local file

host_gates: Exact PR94 source/binary and protected gameplay/PR91/latest-candidate checks; actual-header protocol and Vulkan-Hpp compile tests; two native objects plus full link; at most one 118+2-second isolated GoW test. Preserve candidate and restore PR94; archive evidence and append shared local diary on success/failure.
limitations: Extension may return no useful report. GPU virtual addresses may have page-level precision and need resource correlation; no guilty shader or recovered gameplay is established.
